Low stone platform and four separate displayed cannonballs on their small occupied contact bed. Original abstract geometry replaces portraits, arms, lion faces, inscriptions and plaque text. Surrounding trees, chains/bollards, paths, churches, palaces and all native buildings stay independent; no functioning weapon or navigable interior is asserted. Two actually inspected ordinary whole-side/front-oblique photographs and the cached current standard PMTiles. East-facing muzzle direction is approximate with25-degree uncertainty. Hidden carriage inventory, internal bore/chamber, wheel ornament, lifting hardware and original geometric relief are simplified; no copied figures, arms, lion portrait, lettering or plaque.
